title: Syndicated marketplace listing & coordinated release-notes across AWS/Azure/GCP
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Summary: Coordinate the canonical listing metadata, app-store assets, and release-notes for Redwood Inference across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace. Goal is a synchronized launch that reduces variance in customer-facing copy, compliance artifacts, and pricing disclosures. Scope includes: canonical listing content (feature bullets, screenshots, billing language), release-notes cadence and templating, legal/POA artifacts for each cloud, localized translations for en/ja/de/fr, and CI to push updates to each vendor portal.

Acceptance criteria: (1) Single source-of-truth doc in Drive with approved copy and screenshots. (2) Release notes template created and validated with Engineering and Support. (3) Marketplace-specific checklists (AWS, Azure, GCP) completed and owners assigned. (4) Automated PR checklist (GitHub) that verifies required artifacts before 'go' label. (5) Launch day playbook with contact roster and rollback steps.

Trade-offs and decisions: We debated full localization vs. English-only for initial launch. Decision: ship English + DE/FR for EU compliance and JA for APAC demand; additional locales to follow in a second wave to avoid delaying contracts with enterprise buyers. We also chose to keep published pricing as the canonical SKU mapping rather than dynamic region pricing to simplify vendor approvals; this increases manual reconciliation work post-launch but reduces approval latency.

Risks & mitigations: Vendor portal approval latency (mitigate by parallel submission and contacting partner managers). Compliance gaps (legal to pre-sign POAs; tracked in checklist). Listing copy regressions (use single-source Drive doc + PR gating).

Links & artifacts: PRD (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood/prd-marketplace-2025, Release-notes template (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Marketplace+Release+Notes, GitHub checklist PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/512, Example AWS submission: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/solutions/redwood-inference (staging). Slack channel: #pm-marketplace-launch.

Notes for cross-team work: Engineering (ENG-2610) to provide final screenshots and sample billing CSV. Design (DES-324) to finalize hero assets and 16:9/1:1 screenshots. Legal to review POA and data processing statements by 2025-03-07. Growth to prepare listing SEO keywords and monitoring queries. Support to draft marketplace-specific KB articles and release-notes snippets.

Rollout checklist (high level): 1) Finalize canonical copy and translations (owner: PM) 2) Design assets uploaded to Drive and PR (owner: Design) 3) Engineering verifies billing text and integration links (owner: Eng) 4) Legal signs POAs and compliance matrix (owner: Legal) 5) Submit to AWS/Azure/GCP in parallel with partner contacts looped (owner: PM + Partnerships) 6) Verify acceptance and schedule go-live windows.

Follow-ups after launch: reconcile SKU pricing and billing usage for Dedicated offerings, update Console help text, and run a post-launch retrospective to capture approval bottlenecks.
